name: Simpsons
overview: Scripture teaches believers to exercise discernment by avoiding exposure to wickedness, as seen in Psalms 101:3 where the psalmist commits to setting no wicked thing before his eyes. Proverbs 19:11 highlights the value of discretion and patience in dealing with others, emphasizing the glory in overlooking offenses. Ecclesiastes 7:20 reminds us of the universal reality of sin, affirming that no one is perfectly just. Together, these verses encourage a Christ-centered approach to media and entertainment choices, urging believers to guard their hearts and minds with wisdom and grace.
